g.text: Spatial organization of the full functional network
All original graph connections | recorded positions | line width and shade encode Pearson weight
Connection weight (r) / line width and shade
All 1346 neurons and 12474 edges in EACH panel. Identical positions, connections and node sizes; only colors differ.
Shared positions use 1.8-unit display offsets. Edges represent firing-pattern similarity, not anatomical connections.
